place.name: Sand Mountain Pipeline Designated Dispersed Camping Area

records.issuer: Bureau of Land Management, St. George Field Office
records.quote: Camping along the Sand Mountain Pipeline Road is authorized in eight numbered sites each with a steel fire ring.
conditions: Camping is limited to the eight numbered sites; this area record does not authorize camping at nearby coordinates.
Sites are first come, first served; stay no more than 14 days within a 28-day period.
Follow current fire restrictions and use the steel fire rings for permitted campfires.
